name: Timekeeper adds 2 charges to Timeguard (#1329)
contract: Timekeeper 680845 carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_CHARGES (4) and EffectSpellClassMask word2 134217730 (0x8000002); EffectBasePoints 1 resolves to 2 with DieSides 1, matching the tooltip "Adds $s1 additional charges to Timeguard." Timeguard 804441 has SpellFamilyFlags word2 134217728 (0x8000000) and Spell.dbc ProcCharges 3, so the modified count is 5. Native path only: AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod builds the modifier and Aura::CalcMaxCharges applies SPELLMOD_CHARGES from the caster's spell-mod owner before Aura's constructor stores m_procCharges. The probe uses the same native Player::ApplySpellMod on the record's own ProcCharges, so it needs no cast.
